items.title: Entire Quixel Megascans Library Now Available For Free — and now licensed for AI training
items.excerpt: Epic's Quixel made the full Megascans library free on Fab and updated terms so Megascans and Megaplants can be used to train AI models: 'Your AI models can now learn from real-world scans to help you generate varied, photorealistic environments.'

items.title: 메가스캔 전부 공짜...에픽, AI 학습까지 풀었다
items.excerpt: 퀵셀이 메가스캔 라이브러리 전체를 Fab에서 다시 무료로 풀면서, 메가스캔과 메가플랜츠를 AI 모델 학습에 써도 된다는 조건을 이용약관에 새로 넣었다.

items.title: 3D 에셋 라이브러리 퀵셀 메가스캔, 전면 무료로 전환
items.excerpt: 퀵셀 메가스캔 전체가 Fab을 통해 다시 무료로 전환되고, 2025년 이후 구매자에게는 환급. 메가스캔·메가플랜트 에셋을 AI 모델 학습에 쓸 수 있도록 이용약관을 변경했다.

items.title: GTA6 모회사 대표, "광고비 5만→800달러 비결은 AI"
items.excerpt: 테이크투 스트라우스 젤닉 CEO가 WSJ 테크 행사에서 AI와 불법 복제에 대한 생각을 밝히며, 배우를 써 2만5000~5만 달러 들던 모바일 게임 광고를 AI로 약 800달러에 만든 사례를 소개했다.

items.title: 'I Feel Like Modding is Kind Of Dying' – Mass Effect 3 Multiplayer Modder on AI's Impact on the Scene
items.excerpt: AI has exploded across the modding scene, from mashup mods to full decompilations done by Claude; a veteran Mass Effect 3 multiplayer modder explains how it may be killing the hobby.

items.title: The AI posting war is heating up: 'Please, leave me behind,' says artist who got into it with Epic CEO Tim Sweeney on X
items.excerpt: An artist's public clash with Tim Sweeney over generative AI crystallizes the impasse between pro-AI developers and artists pushing back on AI in games.

items.title: Epic Games' Tim Sweeney Insists AI Adoption 'Unlikely To Be Reversed' As Company Crams AI Into Unreal Engine 6
items.excerpt: At Unreal Fest Tokyo, Tim Sweeney told developers that AI adoption is unlikely to be reversed as Epic builds AI workflows into Unreal Engine 6.

items.title: SAG-AFTRA introduces new process for using actors in game pitches
items.excerpt: A new SAG-AFTRA pre-funding pitch agreement lets devs hire union actors for demos and vertical slices — read as an effort to keep studios from relying on generative AI voices in pre-production.

items.title: SAG-AFTRA launches new video game agreement enabling devs to hire professional actors for demos and vertical slices
items.excerpt: The Pre-Funding Pitch Interactive Media Agreement will 'streamline the hiring of professional union talent' for pitches, demos and vertical slices.

items.title: [인디言] 20년 멈췄던 만화 '굿모닝! 티처' 팬게임의 재시작
items.excerpt: 1990년대 학원 만화 '굿모닝 티처' 팬게임 프로젝트가 AI 기술의 도움을 받아 약 20년 만에 다시 개발돼 첫 빌드를 공개했다. 도키메키 메모리얼 방식의 육성 시뮬레이션.

items.title: Frameboy: Atlas in Real-time
items.excerpt: World Labs released a research preview of Frameboy, streaming its Atlas autoregressive world model from cloud GPUs to the browser at up to 15 fps so users can explore generated worlds in real time; also integrated into the Viewfinder scene-building app.

items.title: 'Hogwarts Legacy' Gets a Magical NVIDIA DLSS 5 Upgrade on GeForce NOW
items.excerpt: Hogwarts Legacy adds DLSS 5 neural rendering, playable on GeForce NOW Ultimate without a hardware upgrade — first of three November DLSS 5 titles.

items.title: Nvidia announces 3 more DLSS 5 games
items.excerpt: Nvidia named three more games getting DLSS 5 neural rendering support, expanding the generative upscaling tech's lineup.

items.title: 顔の変化が物議を醸したこともあったDLSS 5対応『ホグワーツ・レガシー』がGeForce NOWでプレイ可能に
items.excerpt: 顔の変化が物議を醸したDLSS 5対応『ホグワーツ・レガシー』がGeForce NOWで遊べるように。アーティストの意図や作風は維持されるとNVIDIAは説明。

items.title: "로컬 에이전트부터 DLSS 5 게임까지" 엔비디아 'RTX 스파크'의 가능성
items.excerpt: 엔비디아가 로컬 AI 에이전트 구동에 특화된 PC 플랫폼 'RTX 스파크'를 국내 공개. 'NBA 2K27' DLSS 5와 '아이온2' 등 고사양 게임 구동을 지원한다.

items.title: Official Unity plugin for OpenAI's Codex
items.excerpt: Unity launched an official plugin for OpenAI's Codex in OpenAI's universal plugin directory, letting the coding agent work directly with Unity projects.

items.title: Astrocade launches $100K contest to vibe code games using AI
items.excerpt: Prompt-to-game platform Astrocade is running a $100,000 creator competition challenging 25 creators to make viral AI-built playable content; the whole prize goes to the most-played.
